items.text: CONTRIBUTING.md covers building, testing, and the commit style.

turns.prompt: Explain how harbor picks a template for each page

items.text: Every page uses `templates/page.html`. I only read files; nothing changed.

turns.prompt: Check what the build test covers; do not run it

items.text: The test builds a single Markdown page with a Go template and checks the output HTML. I did not run it or modify files.

turns.prompt: Prepare the next release: changelog, version bump, and tag

items.text: CHANGELOG.md lists the build cache and `-force`, the version is 0.4.0, and the tag v0.4.0 is on the release commit.

turns.prompt: Highlight code blocks in rendered pages

items.text: goldmark-highlighting wraps chroma and plugs into goldmark as an extension.

turns.prompt: Write a guide to sharing notebooks

items.text: The sharing guide explains invitations, read-only links, and how to stop sharing.
